name: browser-tool-router
description: Pick the right browser tool before an agent touches a browser, and keep it off your screen.

interface.shortDescription: Pick the right browser tool before touching a browser
interface.longDescription: Routes browser work to the right tool: no browser when a fetch works, headless Chrome for Testing by default, your real logged-in Chrome only for logins and bot walls, and chrome-devtools for performance. Agents work in the background and close what they open.
